https://axiomsystems.systems/how-it-work.body_text_sample: How It Works: Managed Website Design | Axiom Systems Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Call us at (727) 591-7527 Get Started How Website as a Service works We build it. We launch it. Then we keep taking care of it. Axiom designs and builds a custom website for your business, puts it live, and then stays on as the team responsible for it. Here's exactly what happens, from our first conversation to every month after launch. Start my website See the four stages $299 /month Design, build, hosting, updates, backups and support. One monthly price. Your website with Axiom 01 Tell us about your business A conversation, not a questionnaire Start 02 We design and build Custom, around your business Build 03 We refine and launch Your feedback, then we go live Launch 04 We keep managing it Hosting, updates, backups, changes and support Every month Stages 01 to 03 get you live. Stage 04 is what your monthly plan is for. The process Four stages. The last one keeps going. Most website projects end at launch. With Axiom, launch is where the ongoing part of the relationship begins. Here's what happens at each stage, and what we'll need from you. 01 Stage 01 · Getting started Tell us about your business It starts with a conversation, not a pile of forms. We'll ask what you do, who your customers are, where you work and what you want people to do when they find you: call, request a quote, book or stop by. What we do Listen first and ask the right questions Look at your current website, if you have one Walk you through your site's scope and our terms before any work begins What we need from you Your business name, services and service area Your logo and photos of your work, if you have them How you want customers to reach you A little of your time to answer questions No logo or good photos yet? That's common. We'll talk it through together. 02 Stage 02 · Design and build We design and build your website We design a custom site around your business: your services, your photos, your service area and the way you talk to customers. Not a template with your name swapped in. What we take care of A custom design that fits your brand Pages that look and work great on phones Tap-to-call buttons and contact forms Your services and service area laid out clearly Local-search fundamentals built in Your part: answer questions as they come up. Nothing technical. bragspressurewashing.com A recent Axiom build: custom design, clear services, quote and call buttons up front. 03 Stage 03 · Refine and launch We refine it with you, then launch You review a working version of your website on your own phone and computer, not a sketch. Tell us what you'd like changed in plain words and we'll refine it together. When you're happy with it, we take it live. How feedback works You see the real site before your customers do Point out anything that doesn't feel right No design or technical vocabulary needed We make the changes and walk you through them Launch day, handled Hosting set up and ready Your website connected and taken live Forms and call buttons tested Checked on phones, tablets and computers 04 Stage 04 · Every month after launch We keep managing it This is what makes Website as a Service different. Launch isn't the finish line, and you don't get handed a login and a goodbye. Axiom stays responsible for your website, month after month. Hosting Your website lives on secure, managed hosting. We set it up and keep watch over it. Updates The software behind your site needs regular updates. We install them and make sure nothing breaks. Security We keep your site protected, so it stays safe and trustworthy for your customers. Backups Regular backups, so your site can be restored if something ever goes wrong. Changes New service, new photos, new hours? Tell us what changed and we'll update your website. Support Something not looking right? You reach the people who built your site and know it. $299 /month Everything in this stage is part of your plan.

https://axiomsystems.systems/faq/.body_text_sample: FAQ: Managed Website Plans & Pricing | Axiom Systems Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Call us at (727) 591-7527 Get Started FAQ Questions? We've got answers. Straight answers about pricing, what's included and how it works, so you know exactly what you're signing up for. Pricing & billing How much does it cost? Axiom Essential is $299 a month and Axiom Growth is $599 a month, both with a $0 setup fee. Axiom Marketing starts at $1,500 a month, plus advertising spend that you pay directly; a custom setup fee may apply depending on complexity. Submitting the Get Started form doesn't charge you anything: we'll guide you through the next steps first. Is there really no setup fee? Really, for Axiom Essential and Axiom Growth. There's no separate charge for designing or building your website; you simply pay your monthly plan. Axiom Marketing may include a custom setup fee depending on campaign complexity, and we'll tell you before you sign. Can I cancel anytime? Axiom Essential is a monthly subscription you can cancel anytime. Axiom Growth has no long-term contract: you can cancel anytime with 30 days' written notice. Axiom Marketing starts with an initial three-month agreement, and its renewal and cancellation terms are shared before you sign. Why is it monthly instead of one big website payment? Because a website isn't finished the day it launches. It needs hosting, security, software updates and changes as your business grows. Instead of charging thousands upfront and leaving all of that to you, we build your website and then keep hosting, maintaining, updating and supporting it for one monthly price. What's included What's included in Axiom Essential? A professionally designed, conversion-focused website that works on phones, plus managed hosting, SSL and security, maintenance and updates, backups, on-page SEO fundamentals, contact forms, analytics, ongoing support, instant acknowledgment of website inquiries and FREE automated Google review requests. Automation features are available upon activation. Can you update my website after it launches? Yes. Standard updates are part of the service, like changing text, photos, hours, services or contact details. Bigger projects, like a complete redesign or new custom features, go beyond standard updates, and we'll talk those through with you first. Will my website work on phones? Yes. Every Axiom website is built to work on phones, tablets and computers. Most of your customers will see it on a phone first, so we design with that in mind. Do you handle hosting, security and backups? Yes. Managed hosting, SSL, security, software updates and regular backups are all included. You don't need to buy or manage any of it yourself. Can you help with Google and local search? Every website is built with local-search fundamentals: a clean structure, mobile-friendly pages and clear information about your services and service area. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings, and we don't, but your site starts on a solid foundation. Can you connect forms, reviews or booking tools? Usually, yes. Contact and lead forms are included, and we can bring in things like your reviews or an existing booking tool when it makes sense for your business. Every platform is different, so we'll confirm what's possible for your setup. Do you offer more than websites? Yes. Axiom Growth ($599/month) is our complete business system: your website plus Axiom CRM, missed-call text-back, automated lead follow-up, a sales pipeline and appointment reminders. Axiom Marketing (from $1,500/month) adds Google Ads management and landing pages, and works with your existing website. Axiom Lead Automation ($349/month) can also be added to Axiom Essential. See the Pricing and Add-Ons pages for details. What is Axiom CRM? Axiom CRM is the customer management system we set up and manage for Axiom Growth and Axiom Marketing clients. https://axiomsystems.systems/privacy-pol.body_text_sample: Privacy Policy | Axiom Systems Axiom Systems How It Works Our Work Pricing Add-Ons FAQ Call us at (727) 591-7527 Get Started Legal Privacy Policy How Axiom Systems collects, uses and protects information when you visit our website, contact us or use our services. Effective date: October 27, 2026 Overview This Privacy Policy explains how Axiom Systems (“Axiom Systems,” “we,” “us” or “our”) collects, uses and shares information when you visit axiomsystems.systems (the “Website”), contact us, or use our services. Our services include website-as-a-service, web design, website hosting and maintenance, Google Ads management, lead capture, CRM automation, appointment scheduling, automated follow-ups and review request systems. Our services are offered to businesses in the United States. By using the Website or contacting us, you acknowledge the practices described in this policy. 1. Information we collect Information you provide. When you submit our Get Started form, we collect your name, business name, email address, phone number, current website address (optional), what you tell us about your business, and the plan or service you were viewing when you contacted us. When you use the chat widget on our Website, we collect the name, contact details and messages you enter. We also collect information you share when you call, text or email us. Information from clients. If you become a client, we collect the business, billing and account information needed to provide our services, along with the content, images and other materials you give us for your website, campaigns and automations. Information collected automatically. When you visit the Website, we and our service providers automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser and device type, the pages you view, the page that referred you, and the date and time of your visit. When you submit our form, your IP address and browser information are stored with your submission to help us prevent spam and abuse. See “Cookies and analytics” below. Information from third parties. We may receive information from advertising platforms such as Google (for example, the details you submit in a Google Ads lead form, or information about which ad led to your visit) and from people who refer you to us. 2. How we use information We use the information we collect to respond to your inquiries and questions; to schedule and confirm consultations and appointments; to provide, manage and support our services; to manage our client relationships, including billing and account communications; to send marketing communications where permitted by law or where you have agreed to receive them; to measure and improve our Website and our advertising; to protect our Website, our business and our users against spam, fraud and abuse; and to comply with legal obligations and enforce our agreements. 3. Google Ads and lead forms We advertise our services with Google Ads. When you visit our Website after clicking one of our ads, Google may use cookies to measure the ad’s performance. When you successfully submit our Get Started form, our Website reports a conversion to Google Ads so we can see which ads produce inquiries. This report contains a reference number for the submission; it does not include the answers you entered in the form. If we run ads that include a Google lead form and you submit it, Google provides the information you enter (such as your name, email address and phone number) to us so we can respond to your request, and we add it to our CRM. Google’s collection and use of information is governed by the Google Privacy Policy . 4. CRM and automation Inquiries from our Get Started form are saved on our Website, emailed to our team, and transferred to our customer relationship management (CRM) system, which is built on the GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) platform.
